name: Pipeliners - Blog Indexing Investigation 2026-09-17
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-17

# Summary
Read-only investigation into why 22 blog posts were not in Google (Sep 17, 2026). Nothing was technically blocking them: all load, are indexable, self-canonical and in the sitemap. Google was choosing not to index them.

# Key findings
- Bulk upload: 27 posts were published at the same two timestamps on Mar 5, 2025. Of 28 batch posts, 18 are not indexed (64%); of 26 posts written one at a time, only 1 is not indexed.
- Thin and generic: not-indexed batch posts have a median 665 words vs 1,109 for indexed batch posts; most lack subheadings, images and local detail, and use stock AI phrases.
- Topic overlap with stronger indexed Pipeliners pages (cost, what trenchless is, corrosion, tree roots, leaks, warning signs, myths).
- No links: 12 of 22 get no in-content links.
- Some were only ever found through the old broken sitemaps; the 2025 homeowners guide was unknown to Google.

# Decisions and status
- Per-post recommendations: improve (cost guide, myths, gurgling drains, checkup post, leak detection rewrite pending Scott), merge (what is trenchless, tree roots, pipelining myths, DIY leak tips and others) or update.
- These fed the blog merges draft (live Sep 19) and the not-indexed improvement rounds of Sep 28 to 29.
